== Biography ==

== Trivia ==
* Used to play soccer on semi-pro level.
* After reaching Diamond on the Russian server by the end of Season 3, he reached Challenger in Season 4. He maintained that rank prior to his transfer on EU West, before Season 7.<ref>https://ru.op.gg/summoner/userName=mrnomanz</ref>
* Was back-to-back playoff MVP in [[LCL]] throughout the 2020 season.
* Made a brief appearance on ''Evening Urgant'' (a popular Russian late-night talk show) on November 6, 2020 where he taught the host how to play League of Legends.<ref>https://youtu.be/wZ5YXQ2uNeQ</ref>
